title: Kessler Shield Labor Points Bonus — Service Accounts and Repair Orders Owner Rewards
content:
The service contract labor bonus on a Service Accounts and Repair Orders paid repair order follows the vehicle's Kessler Shield contract, as the Kessler Shield Vehicle Service Contracts records show, and the account's tier. The vehicle is the vehicle on the paid repair order's labor charges.

| Vehicle carries an active Kessler Shield service contract | Account tier | More points per whole dollar of customer-pay labor charged on the paid repair order |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Gold or Platinum | 2 |
| Yes | Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 1 |
| Otherwise | — | none; labor earns no bonus |

The whole dollars of customer-pay labor charged are the paid repair order's customer-pay labor charges, cents dropped. Only a contract whose status is active counts.

**Hypothetical.** Customer-pay labor charged of 287.90 on a Gold account whose vehicle carries an active contract: 287 whole dollars, 574 more points. On a Silver account: 287 more points.
